meta.title: Trial to Paid
meta.subtitle: The first week of a self-serve workspace
meta.persona: Solo founder, evaluating on a weekend

cards.title: The dip
items: Sentiment bottoms out when the row limit appears without warning
The banner is the first mention of any limit
Half of trials churn at this stage

cards.title: Recovery
items: Pricing page reads clearly but arrives too late
Checkout is short; sentiment only recovers to neutral

cards.title: Proposed fix
items: Show a row-count meter from the first import
Offer the upgrade inside the banner, not on a separate page
